High-Speed Chase Ends in chain Collision: Multiple Injured ​on E19 Highway NOS News • Today, 4:06 AM • Amended ​Today, 6:44 ‍AM
In a​ dramatic turn of events, a high-speed chase by the Dutch police ended in a⁣ chain collision on ‌the E19 highway at Loenhout, Belgium, just across the border from Breda.⁣ Several people were injured in ⁣the incident, which unfolded after a car with French‌ license plates was flagged ⁤for suspicious driving behaviour.
The Pursuit Begins The chase began in Noord-Brabant, where police officers‌ attempted to stop a vehicle with French license plates due to its suspicious driving ⁢behavior. According to the ⁤Gazet van Antwerpen, the driver‍ refused to comply and ‍fled the ⁣scene. The ⁤pursuit continued,‍ and the car eventually collided with another⁤ vehicle ⁣at‍ Hazeldonk, resulting in material ​damage but no immediate injuries.
The ⁣Fatal Turn As the chase ⁤continued into Belgium, the fleeing ⁣driver lost‍ control of the vehicle‌ and crashed into several other cars. The Belgian newspaper ‌reported that the driver sustained serious injuries and was‍ rushed to the hospital. The ‍collision caused meaningful disruption ​and chaos on the E19 highway, with multiple vehicles‌ involved ‍and several people⁣ injured.
The Aftermath The⁣ incident highlights the risks and challenges associated with high-speed chases.Authorities are now ⁢investigating‍ the cause of the collision and the circumstances leading up to the chase. The injured individuals are receiving medical attention, and updates on thier condition are expected soon.

The accident occurred in ⁢the late afternoon, causing a significant ​traffic jam in the area. ⁤According to‍ eyewitnesses, a high-speed chase ensued shortly after the initial collision , exacerbating the situation as another car drove at high​ speed through⁢ the⁣ tail of the traffic jam. This reckless maneuver resulted in a⁤ chain⁣ collision that left six people injured, one of whom was critically injured and rushed to the hospital.
Emergency responders,‌ including the fire brigade, ⁢worked swiftly ⁢to free one trapped victim from the wreckage. Five cars were ​reported to be severely damaged in the​ accident. The⁤ highway in the direction of Antwerp was subsequently closed for several hours, although the disruption was minimized as the accident occurred ‍in a parking lot, allowing traffic to be diverted.
police have since arrested the driver in the hospital, although the reasons for their suspicious behavior remain unclear. The investigation is ongoing, and authorities are urging anyone with‍ information about the incident to come forward.
